scenes.text: In Sri Lanka, heat means humid air, and warmer nights.
The Disaster Management Centre issues warm weather advisories: in 2026, in April, August and October.

A heat-health action plan is listed in Sri Lanka’s climate commitments to 2035. A national roadmap for acting before disasters was launched in June 2026. And Colombo has guidelines for a heat plan that sees women’s work.
Acting before the heat, not after it.
